crossRefs.note: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around…

translations.web: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
translations.bsb: You are also to make two gold rings and fasten them to the two corners of the breastpiece.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
translations.asv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
